title.value: EpiK-Eval: Evaluation for Language Models as Epistemic Models
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: EpiK-Eval: Evaluation for Language Models as Epistemic Models

extractions.description: The paper introduces EpiK-Eval, a question-answering benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of large language models (LLMs) to consolidate knowledge from segmented narratives. It reveals weaknesses in LLMs' ability to form a coherent knowledge representation from multiple training documents, attributing this to the nature of prevailing training objectives.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on evaluating and improving the knowledge consolidation capabilities of language models, which is a general AI research problem. While improved AI could potentially be used for sustainable development applications, it is not the central theme of this paper.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Developing systems that can reason through language understanding has been a cornerstone in natural language processing research. Recent progress ... has showcased notable advancements in a variety of reasoning tasks
